auditor_stance: adversarial; harness is the defendant; redaction carries a confidentiality/data-leak dimension

confidentiality_summary.text_redaction_flate_blindness: ADDRESSED. Completeness + phase7 decompress the content stream (pdfe::testsupport::decompressedPageContent) and grep the DECODED operators, explicitly noting the old raw-ASCII grep was Flate-blind. Extraction-based checks (extractPlainText/stext) are backstopped by the decompressed-stream check.
confidentiality_summary.image_pixel_destruction: ADDRESSED. test_fidelity_r3_23_image_redaction renders and asserts every interior pixel of the redacted image sub-region is wiped to the colorspace-white cleared fill and NO pixel still shows the original raster; control asserts pixels outside survive. This is the only test that proves the raster (not just the /XObject ref) is destroyed.
confidentiality_summary.boundary_straddle_intersection_vs_contai: ADDRESSED. test_redaction_partial_overlap builds a region that intersects every glyph but contains none and asserts checkTextRemoved returns FALSE (intersection semantics of the b63ad8c fix), plus a full-containment control.
confidentiality_summary.residual_confidentiality_escape: The STRONGEST byte/pixel-absence oracles are CONDITIONALLY SKIPPED unless the specific known-secret fixture test_redaction.pdf is present (completeness:67-69, phase7:428-430; roundtrip text-absence is #ifndef _WIN32 skipped). If that fixture is absent (or on Linux for the extraction path), confidentiality assurance silently degrades to counter/no-throw proxies and the suite still reports green.
confidentiality_summary.verifier_self_coverage: The RedactionVerifier's OWN unit file (test_redaction_verifier.cpp) never asserts checkTextRemoved returns FALSE for genuine leftover text on a real PDF; its only FALSE cases are non-PDF/nonexistent files, and VerifyResult_HasCorrectFields is tautological. Positive leak-detection lives only in test_redaction_edge_cases (CheckTextRemoved_TextStillPresent, B4/B5/B6).

per_file.note: Confidentiality-strong: intersection-vs-containment security regression. PartiallyOverlappingLeftoverTextIsDetected@67 asserts checkTextRemoved==FALSE for a boundary-straddling glyph; FullyContainedTextStillDetected@93 control.

Best-in-cluster. ImagePixelsUnderRedactionAreDestroyed@160 renders reopened doc and asserts stillOriginal==0 AND notCleared==0 over interior; ImagePixelsOutsideRedactionSurvive@260 control. Proves raster destruction, not just XObject removal.

Pixel-black ROI means (RedactedRegionPixelsAreBlackAfterApply@86) + text substring absence (@119) + untouched-neighbor pixel match (@200). Text-absence test SKIPPED on non-Windows (@120-128); ApplyClearsMarks@250 & corrupt-xref@271 are state/reopen-only.

Bulk is null-guard EXPECT_THROW + panel formatting (legit contracts). Confidentiality-strong core: CheckTextRemoved_TextStillPresent@646 (EXPECT_FALSE on unredacted full-page = the verifier's real positive-detection test), B4 RedactionOnEncryptedPdf@1489 (secret absent after redact+re-encrypt+reopen), B5 RedactionPreservesAnnotations@1584, B6 OcrTextLayerRedaction@1673 (hidden Tr=3 layer stripped).

AppliedRedactionRemovesSecretTextBytes@427 is the strong truth oracle (SSN absent from extraction AND decompressed stream + control survives) but GTEST_SKIPs unless fixture==test_redaction.pdf@428. AppliedRedactionPersistsThroughSaveReopen@397 is honestly-labeled reopen-only proxy. Rotate check reads back the CTM it wrote (@268).

EditCommittedBeforeApplyPersists@93 asserts sentinel survives via extraction; ApplyWithoutPriorEdit@197 negative. Header claims 'redacted region content removed' but no assertion verifies redaction completeness — only the text-edit-persistence half is tested.

UI contract: delete-click emits deleteMarkRequested with correct (page,annot) payload@128, no-selection emits nothing@156, disabled marks filtered@181. Not a confidentiality test; genuine signal/row-count oracle.

Command model: mark-count deltas, undo/redo symmetry, property readback (fillColor/overlayText/rect), merge rules. Real for the undo model; several tests assert only description() literal strings; NONE assert actual content removal (by design — roundtrip covers that).

State-management: mark count/index/property/hit-test are true for the manager layer, but ApplyPageRedactions@234 asserts only NO_THROW + marks-cleared-to-0 — no content/pixel check. This is exactly the gap test_redaction_roundtrip's header says it closes.

Apply workflow asserts result.success/marksApplied/pagesAffected counters + marks consumed — no bytes/pixels. VerifyAfterApply@209 delegates to verifier.verify()==success (proxy on top of a weakly-self-tested verifier). Panel tests are genuine widget contracts (button-enable, signal signature@442).

RedactedTextAbsentFromBytes@51 is strong (decompressed-stream grep, Flate-aware) but GTEST_SKIPs@67 unless fixture==test_redaction.pdf. The other 3 are weak: RedactionUndoDoesNotRestoreAfterSave@96 NEVER tests undo (only pageCount>=1); MultipleRedactionMarksApplied@117 is NO_THROW+exists; FullPageRedaction@137 is pageCount-equal only.

WEAKEST redaction file. VerifyResult_HasCorrectFields@107 is textbook tautology (EXPECT_TRUE(x||!x)@114-117; unsigned>=0@119-120). ConstructDestroy@41 SUCCEED(). checkTextRemoved only asserted TRUE (empty/no-text) or FALSE (bad files); no positive-leak FALSE on a real PDF in THIS file — the security-detector's own unit file barely constrains it. Fail-path tests (non-PDF) are legit.
POD accessor/predicate tests with exact-value oracles (pixelArea@69, colorSpaceString map@96-127). Low-value but genuinely fails on regression.
Strong: exact kernel values@67, bit-exact identity/routing@143, preserved white/black. DownscaleAntiAliases@181 (named for AA) asserts only qAlpha>=253 at one corner — never measures smoothing.
Genuine per-region DPI value oracle vs known fixture geometry (nearDpi 150 vs 300@85; differential thumbDpi<photoDpi*0.75@113). Directly locks the reported regression.
Real pixel readback: masked channels EXPECT_NEAR(center.red,255,20)@65. Feather-edge band asserted with loose 20..235 range@121-122 that any non-extreme value satisfies.
Save+reopen count deltas@89 + real EXIF byte-scan bytes.find(exifSig)==npos@206. Jpeg2000 test degrades to reopen-non-null@259 with no content assertion.

CropBox geometry round-trips through undo/redo/save-reopen (EXPECT_NEAR width@62,@117). Asserts the /CropBox dict value, not that rendered content is clipped. OutOfRangePageIndexNoOps@131 ends in bare SUCCEED().
Renders converted page and asserts R==G==B (allPixelsAreGray@91). Samples only every 8th pixel, tol=4 — a residual color patch <8px could slip; genuinely visual though.
Real algorithmic oracle: exact line-break text@93 + justifyExtraSpace FLOAT_EQ@166. Only ReflowAdaptive@204-205 degrades to inequalities and @227 is a wall-clock budget.
Genuine print raster oracle: ink check + EXPECT_GE(ncc,0.70)@174 + discrimination sameNcc>crossNcc@206. 0.70 NCC floor + only page 0 tested leaves headroom for partial-content loss.
Verifies page count + geometry (widthPt NEAR 300@77) but never renders — a wizard emitting correctly-sized BLANK pages passes every assertion.
Panel state/signals genuine (spy.count@354, spin NEAR@179). HasAllWidgets@46 pure existence; DPI oracle dpiText.contains('72')@145 weak substring a '720'/'1972' satisfies.
Strong visual oracle: crops a known colored block and asserts sampled centre colour dRed<60@202 & dBlue>120@205 — pins MediaBox origin offset AND Y-flip against pixels.
Measures the ambient-CTM leak in rendered geometry: bb.w>150 (expected ~200, halved ~100)@124 + untouched-neighbor glyph geometry/colour@157-161. Discriminates the bug from pixels.
Parametrized UAF: ASSERT_NO_THROW(undo)@300 backed by observable image-count deltas + ctmMaxDelta<0.5@315. No-throw is the correct detector for a heap-UAF crash; not no-throw-only.
Detected DPI vs filename-declared DPI within 5%@99. Sound relation but all 4 self-skip when gitignored fixtures absent@105 → false-green on CI without gen_fixtures.py.
NCC/MSE identity real (EXPECT_NEAR(ncc,1.0,0.01)@76) but OtsuThresholdBimodal accepts any threshold in [20,230]@65-66 for modes 20/230 — a broken Otsu returning 21 or 229 passes.
Every render test asserts only non-transparent PIXEL COUNT>0@81, never glyph shape/position — garbled/wrong-glyph output with any ink passes. ConstructAndDestroy@62 pure NO_THROW.

State/signal contracts real (Deselect@141, Delete removeRequested@182). Paint/NullEvent NO_THROW-only@235,250; selection tests self-skip if click misses hit-test@174,213 — a broken hit-test silently voids the assertion.

Asserts internal cache counters not user-visible results; constant restated against itself@66. The 3 real-eviction tests depend on a hardcoded Desktop PDF and GTEST_SKIP on CI@228 — the byte-budget eviction (the point of C2) never runs in CI.

Add-intent tests assert only bool hasOutputIntent()@55 after reopen — never the ICC stream bytes/N-components. AddSrgbOutputIntent_VerifyStream@101 does NOT inspect the stream. ConstructDestroy@34 SUCCEED().
Insert/remove verified only by enumerated-image COUNT delta@59 — never the inserted image's pixels/rect/DPI. Undo/redo count-symmetry only. DestructorSafety ends SUCCEED()@456.

One genuine truth oracle (StripExif_Static_RemovesGps textKeys().isEmpty()@107). But ALL PDF-path tests assert only return bool/count@148,226 and never reopen the saved PDF to confirm EXIF gone from embedded image bytes — the shipped-file privacy guarantee is unverified.
Pattern-substitution tests are exact-string@52. But every end-to-end export asserts only file COUNT@119 / non-null reopen@141 — blank/black/wrong-page/wrong-DPI export passes.
Every mutation asserts only bool return + unchanged count@63,89. resizeImage/rotateImage/cropImage that silently no-ops or corrupts the CTM passes all 12 — no-op is indistinguishable from correct.

replace() validated only by echoed struct fields (approach/editedText)@171-173 — never the masked/re-rendered pixels. The ghost-text/mirror defects this project repeatedly hits would pass. MoveConstructor@146 empty NO_THROW.

Advertised 'PdfCanvas rendering oracle' only asserts display list non-null@71 — never rasterizes, so a visually-wrong rotate/crop passes. Rotate judged by CTM-array delta>0.01@123; panel tests pure findChild@246.

Insert/remove asserted purely by in-memory count delta@271 (no save/reopen, no pixels); extract only non-null/dimensions@467. 27 GTEST_SKIP fixture-guards → whole suite SKIPPED-green when fixtures absent.

Pervasive tautology: computeExpandedWidth tests recompute the production ratio*1.2 formula in-test then compare@189-192,227-231; renderBbox union recomputed with std::min/max in test body@286-300; atlas-skip 'oracle' is a boolean of local vars@705,833. AtlasSetterWorks@445 never calls the setter.

Layer VISIBILITY (the user-visible behavior) never rendered: setVisible(false);isVisible()==false@96-97 round-trips a stored flag — an OCG /OFF state never written to the PDF (render ignores it) still passes. ConstructDestroy@37 SUCCEED().

Print output content never inspected: EXPECT_TRUE(result)@84 + fileSize>0@92 pass for blank/wrong-page/garbage PDF. PrintEngineConstruction@45 SUCCEED(). Mitigated only by the separate fidelity_r3_21 file.

Dominant oracle EXPECT_NE(xobjBefore,xobjAfter)@317 proves a change not the correct edit. Font-cap test recomputes production formula in-test@1626 then asserts@1629 (tautological). 41 GTEST_SKIP → fixture/tessdata-less run goes green with zero image-edit coverage.
Only a raw pointer setter/getter@41. RepaintRequestedSignal emits the signal itself then asserts it was received@92-93 — tests Qt's moc, not product behavior.

ranked_weak_findings.user_visible_failure_missed: The single decompressed-stream byte-absence assertion (the one test in this file that proves the redacted secret is gone from Flate-compressed content) is GTEST_SKIPPED@67-69 whenever SetUp falls back from test_redaction.pdf to test_single.pdf. In that config a redaction that paints a box but leaves the secret's Tj operators intact ships GREEN. Redacted SSN survives in the saved stream; nothing catches it.

The strongest text-redaction truth oracle (SSN absent from extraction AND decompressed content stream, control survives) GTEST_SKIPs@428-430 unless the fixture is exactly test_redaction.pdf. Under fixture absence the redaction P0 coverage collapses to mark-count/index proxies (UI-RED-01..05) — a real leak escapes green.

The security VERIFIER's own unit file constrains it almost not at all: EXPECT_TRUE(result.success||!result.success)@114-117 and EXPECT_GE(unsigned,0)@119-120 are always-true; ConstructDestroy@41 is SUCCEED(). checkTextRemoved is only ever asserted TRUE (empty/no-text) here; no test in this file asserts it returns FALSE for genuine leftover text on a real PDF. A mutation making checkTextRemoved always-return-true (never detect a leak) passes this entire file — positive detection is caught ONLY in test_redaction_edge_cases:646.

All PDF-path EXIF strips assert only a return bool/count@148,226 and never reopen the saved PDF to inspect the embedded image XObject bytes. A no-op strip that touches the images but removes no GPS/camera metadata passes — the privacy guarantee (EXIF actually gone from the shipped file) is unverified on the real product path (only the in-memory QImage path is checked).

resize/rotate/crop that returns true but does not alter the XObject geometry — or writes a wrong CTM producing a mirrored/half-size image (the exact bug class fixed in a03f6b6/half-size-under-CTM) — passes: the only assertions are EXPECT_TRUE(result) and unchanged count. A no-op is indistinguishable from correct.

The file advertises a 'PdfCanvas rendering oracle' but verifyDisplayListOracle only asserts the display list is non-null@71 — never rasterizes. An image inserted at the wrong position, rotated the wrong way, or rendered invisibly still builds a valid display list and passes. Rotate correctness reduces to CTM-array delta>0.01@123, which any CTM perturbation satisfies.

Text-into-image replacement validated only by echoed struct fields (approach==C, editedText==input)@171-173. If the masker fails to erase the original scanned text, or the new glyphs render blank/mispositioned/mirrored (defects this subsystem has repeatedly hit), the test still reports success.

On any runner lacking tessdata/eng.traineddata or the scanned fixtures (a realistic CI config) ~30-41 of 42 tests GTEST_SKIP and the file reports GREEN with zero image-text-edit verification — a totally broken ImageReplacer ships undetected. No unconditional smoke assertion. Dominant surviving oracle EXPECT_NE(xobjBefore,xobjAfter)@317 proves only that something changed.

The ghost-text renderBbox-union fix AND the pixel-width-expansion formula are re-implemented inside the test body (@286-300, @189-192) then asserted against copies of themselves — production ImageReplacer is never invoked. A regression in the actual union/width path would not fail these tests; they only prove std::min/std::max and ceil() work.

The test name promises 'undo does not restore redacted content after save' — a real confidentiality property — but the body never invokes undo and asserts only reopened->pageCount()>=1@114. If undo-after-save DID resurrect the redacted secret (a plausible UAF/rebind bug this project tracks), this test stays green.

Apply is asserted only by NO_THROW + marks-cleared-to-0@238-241. A redaction that clears the mark list and reports done but removes NO content passes. This is exactly the gap test_redaction_roundtrip's header cites; acceptable here only because roundtrip/edge_cases carry the real oracle — in isolation the manager's core operation is content-blind.

Toggling a layer invisible that does NOT hide its content on the rendered page (OCG /OFF never written to the PDF, or render ignores OCG config) passes — the test only reads back the in-memory flag it just set via isVisible()@96-97; the page is never rendered, no pixels checked. Hidden-content-still-visible = an information-disclosure escape for layered PDFs.

PrintEngine emitting a blank page, wrong page, or garbage passes: EXPECT_TRUE(result)@84 + fileSize>0@92 pass for any non-empty PDF. Content-blind within this file; mitigated only by the separate test_fidelity_r3_21 raster oracle.

Insert/remove verified by in-memory count delta only@271,392 (no save/reopen, no pixel/placement). An insert that adds the XObject but never references it in the content stream (invisible image) or places it off-page passes. Plus 27 GTEST_SKIP guards → whole suite SKIPPED-green when fixtures absent.

Wizard producing correctly-counted, correctly-sized pages that are BLANK (image decode/embed silently dropped): widthPt NEAR 300@77 checks only geometry, no render/pixel check confirms the source image is actually visible.

Named 'VerifyStream' but only checks hasOutputIntent()==true@112. A corrupt/empty/wrong-N-component or non-sRGB ICC profile still satisfies the boolean — a structurally-present-but-invalid PDF/A OutputIntent is never caught.

The only tests exercising real byte-budget eviction depend on a hardcoded absolute path to a private PDF on the author's Desktop@164 and GTEST_SKIP otherwise@228. On CI the eviction logic — the entire point of C2 — never runs, so an eviction regression ships green.

Invisible-text (Tr=3) edit that actually paints faint visible glyphs: imagesAreDifferent(...,0.05)@1797 tolerates up to 5% of pixels changing before failing; thin overlaid text on a busy scan stays under 5%, so a Tr-mode regression that makes OCR text visible passes.
Only asserts >0 non-transparent pixels. Wrong glyphs, mirrored text, wrong font, or a single stray dot all pass — no positional/shape/OCR check ties output to the input string.
Accepts any threshold in [20,230] for a bimodal image whose modes ARE 20 and 230 — essentially the entire meaningful range. An Otsu returning 21 or 229 (useless as a split) passes.

Manually emits the signal then asserts it was received@92-93 — proves only Qt's moc/QSignalSpy work; cannot fail for any product defect. The real contract (mouse selection triggers repaintRequested) is not exercised.
All 4 DPI tests GTEST_SKIP when the gitignored generated fixtures are absent@105 → on CI without gen_fixtures.py the DPI-detection metamorphic relation is never checked and the file is green.

Mislabeled DPI (e.g. '720' or a stray '72' from another field): dpiText.contains('72')@145 is a bare substring any string containing '72' satisfies; the pixel-dimension label was hardened with a regex@135 but the DPI label was left weak.
